verdict.rationale: The OpenAI Agents SDK is a developer framework. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in, product-level feature that gives users AI-generated insights or suggestions from their own data. FileSearchTool, CodeInterpreterTool, function tools and the Traces dashboard are building blocks a developer could use to construct such a feature, or debugging aids, not the capability itself. So they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
